_comment: Quests. `story` is one chain in order: each quest's goal is checked against your castle and its reward (resources, soldiers) is given in full when you claim it, even past the storage cap. Daily tasks show `text` with the target, or `one` when the target is 1. Goal kinds: building (`count` buildings of `type` at `level` or higher), soldiers (in the garrison), stat (lifetime: trained soldiers, spent resources, beaten robber barons, looted resources), production (`resource` per hour), storage, levels (all building levels added up). `daily` tasks are picked anew every day at 00:00 UTC: `picks` of the `kinds` (fewer without a barracks for the kinds that need one), with the target and reward for the keep level you had when the day began. The reward of each kind is multiplied by `scale` for that keep level. Finishing every daily task opens the coffer; days in a row raise it by `streak_bonus` each, up to `max_streak`, and on the last one it also gives `streak_troops` (times `scale`).

chapters.title: Ashes and Timber
chapters.intro: My lord, the Black Baron's riders burned this valley before you came. Little is left but ash and good soil. Let us rebuild.

chapters.title: Steel and Bread
chapters.intro: Smoke rises on the eastern road again. The Baron's men are robbing the farms. We need soldiers, and bread to feed them.

chapters.title: The Black Baron
chapters.intro: A captured raider talked: the robber camps all pay tribute to one man, the Black Baron. Every camp we burn makes him weaker.

chapters.title: Walls of Stone
chapters.intro: The Baron knows your name now. He is gathering his lieutenants. Thick walls and a deep keep will keep your people safe.

chapters.title: The Black Baron Falls
chapters.intro: His lieutenants are dead or fled. Only the Baron's own hoard and pride remain. Finish this, and the valley is yours.

story.title: Fresh Timber
story.text: Every castle starts with wood. Put the woodcutters to work properly.

story.title: Stone from the Hills
story.text: The hills behind the keep are full of good stone. Open a quarry.

story.title: Full Granaries
story.text: Hungry people don't build. Two farms will do for now.

story.title: Townsfolk
story.text: Craftsmen pay taxes, my lord. Give them a decent house.

story.title: A Lord's Seat
story.text: A bigger keep means more builders and more room. Raise it.

story.title: Raise the Barracks
story.text: We can't fight the Baron with pitchforks. Build a barracks.

story.title: First Recruits
story.text: Train some spearmen. Twenty would be a good start.

story.title: Smoke on the Road
story.text: There's a robber camp on the map. Send your soldiers and burn it.

story.title: Bread for an Army
story.text: Soldiers eat all day. Grow 150 food an hour.

story.title: Room to Store
story.text: Our cellars overflow. A storehouse keeps the harvest safe.

story.title: Bowmen
story.text: A level 2 barracks can train archers. The Baron's spearmen fear them.

story.title: Stone Walls
story.text: Wooden palisades burn. Raise the castle wall to level 2.

story.title: Seat of Power
story.text: A level 3 keep tells the Baron you're here to stay.

story.title: Burn the Outposts
story.text: Beat 5 robber camps. Each one is a tooth pulled from the Baron's mouth.

story.title: Spoils of War
story.text: What the robbers stole should come home. Bring back 3,000 loot.

story.title: A Proper Garrison
story.text: Keep 100 soldiers at home, so no raider dares come near.

story.title: Swordsmiths
story.text: A level 3 barracks trains swordsmen, the backbone of any army.

story.title: A Growing Town
story.text: Your town is growing fast. Reach 80 building levels in total.

story.title: The Great Keep
story.text: Raise the keep to level 4. More builders, more storage, more respect.

story.title: Unbreakable
story.text: The Baron is gathering siege ladders. Raise the wall to level 4.

story.title: Hunt the Lieutenants
story.text: His lieutenants hide in the bigger camps. Beat 20 robber camps in all.

story.title: Coin of the Realm
story.text: Wars are won with gold. Earn 800 gold an hour.

story.title: Riders
story.text: A level 4 barracks can train horsemen. Nothing runs down archers faster.

story.title: Deep Cellars
story.text: Make room for 20,000 of every resource.

story.title: The Iron Crown
story.text: Raise the keep to level 5. The whole valley will see it from afar.

story.title: A Thousand Spears
story.text: Train 1,000 soldiers in all. The Baron's men are deserting to us already.

story.title: Cleansing the Valley
story.text: Beat 50 robber camps. Leave the Baron nowhere to hide.

story.title: The Baron's Hoard
story.text: Take back what he stole. Bring home 50,000 loot in all.

story.title: The Last Wall
story.text: A level 5 wall. Let him break his teeth on it.

story.title: Master of the Valley
story.text: Reach 300 building levels. The Black Baron is gone, and the valley is yours, my lord.
